records.part: Upgrade of existing Philips Epiq 7 ultrasound systems (12 units) to EPIQ Elite advanced for general imaging, hardware and software
records.reason: The original equipment manufacturer (OEM), Philips, is the only contractor who can provide the upgrade and as such is a logical follow-on to the original contract, due to the need to operate with existing OEM’S components and the proprietary nature of the hardware and software.
